title: Sheep holding a heart
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- fluffy wool body -->
  <g fill="#f2f0ea">
    <circle cx="38" cy="58" r="15"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="52" r="14"/>
    <circle cx="64" cy="60" r="14"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="66" r="14"/>
    <circle cx="58" cy="45" r="11"/>
    <circle cx="40" cy="45" r="11"/>
  </g>
  <!-- wool shading -->
  <g fill="#dcd8cc">
    <circle cx="46" cy="68" r="6"/>
    <circle cx="66" cy="64" r="6"/>
    <circle cx="36" cy="62" r="5"/>
  </g>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="40" y="72" width="6" height="14" rx="2" fill="#4a4a52"/>
  <rect x="58" y="72" width="6" height="14" rx="2" fill="#4a4a52"/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x="39" y="84" width="8" height="5" rx="2" fill="#2c2c34"/>
  <rect x="57" y="84" width="8" height="5" rx="2" fill="#2c2c34"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="46" rx="13" ry="11" fill="#c9c2b4"/>
  <!-- wool tuft on head -->
  <g fill="#f2f0ea">
    <circle cx="26" cy="35" r="6"/>
    <circle cx="34" cy="34" r="6"/>
    <circle cx="30" cy="31" r="5"/>
  </g>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx="18" cy="42" rx="5" ry="3.5" fill="#b0a898" transform="rotate(-20 18 42)"/>
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="40" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#b0a898" transform="rotate(20 42 40)"/>
  <!-- face -->
  <ellipse cx="24" cy="48" rx="3" ry="3.5" fill="#3a3a44"/>
  <ellipse cx="33" cy="48" rx="2.5" ry="3" fill="#3a3a44"/>
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="53" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#e8a0a0"/>
  <circle cx="24" cy="47" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="33" cy="47" r="0.9" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="58" rx="5" ry="3.5" fill="#e6ded0"/>
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="56.5" rx="2" ry="1.5" fill="#8a4a4a"/>
  <!-- heart held in front -->
  <path d="M68 74 C 62 66, 56 72, 68 82 C 80 72, 74 66, 68 74 Z" fill="#ff4d6d"/>
  <path d="M68 76 C 64 71, 60 74, 68 81 C 76 74, 72 71, 68 76 Z" fill="#ff8fa3"/>
  <!-- little arm holding heart -->
  <circle cx="62" cy="70" r="4" fill="#c9c2b4"/>
</svg>
